list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT jsonb_object_keys(scalars) FROM points WHERE $__timeFilter(t_start)

target.rawSql: SELECT t_start AS time, coalesce(t_end, now()) AS timeend, 'rid ' || rid || ' ' || class_name || ' (' || status || ')' AS text, class_name AS tags FROM runs WHERE t_start < $__timeTo() AND coalesce(t_end, now()) > $__timeFrom()

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, $__interval), field AS metric, avg(value) AS value FROM readings WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND measurement = '$measurement' AND (cardinality(ARRAY[$field]::text[]) = 0 OR '__all' = ANY(ARRAY[$field]::text[]) OR field = ANY(ARRAY[$field]::text[])) AND (cardinality(ARRAY[$system]::text[]) = 0 OR '__all' = ANY(ARRAY[$system]::text[]) OR tags->>'system' = ANY(ARRAY[$system]::text[])) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT t_end AS time, (scalars ->> '$scalar')::float AS "$scalar" FROM points WHERE $__timeFilter(t_start) AND scalars ? '$scalar' ORDER BY 1

SELECT rid, class_name, label, status, t_start, t_end, points_done, points_total, h5_path, (extract(epoch FROM t_start - w.margin) * 1000)::bigint AS from_ms, (extract(epoch FROM coalesce(t_end, now()) + w.margin) * 1000)::bigint AS to_ms FROM runs CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT greatest((coalesce(t_end, now()) - t_start) * 0.1, interval '30 seconds') AS margin) w WHERE $__timeFilter(t_start) ORDER BY rid DESC
